newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude grades gain strength in active session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude grades gain strength in active session.

text.p: Key domestic cash crude grades increased in value Monday afternoon, gaining strength along with the March/April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing spread.
March grade business took on a more frantic pace a day before the Tuesday deadline for pipeline scheduling.

Traders said U.S. Gulf refiners were buying-up their remaining March barrels at firmer prices, notably in the Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, where deals bumped to WTI/Cushing plus 50 cents, 10-15 cts higher than late Friday.
Even floundering West Texas Sour/Midland found support, selling at WTI/Cushing minus $2.65, 10-15 cts stronger.
